top_signals.title: Fed's Waller Supports Rate Hike in December
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he supports an interest-rate hike in December, and warned that if inflation continues to accelerate he would support a half-percentage-point increase to protect the central bank’s credibility. “If inflation comes in substantially higher than I expect, more robust action by the FOMC may be called for,” Waller said at the Bank of England and Its Watchers event. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Inflation Data to Test Limits of Treasury Rally After Haven Bid
top_signals.summary: Bond traders are waiting for a key inflation report for clues on the direction of the Federal Reserve’s policy path and whether the recent Treasury rally has more room to run.
